_README: Fallback references used when a product has fewer than min_fingerprint_n crowd scans. Ranges are PLACEHOLDER guesses from basic chemistry, NOT measured on our rig. TODO(calibrate): replace every range with mean +/- 3 std from 5+ real scans of a representative product per class, under the locked sample-prep protocol.

classes.name: B-complex / riboflavin-containing
classes.why: Riboflavin is yellow: absorbs strongly in blue, little in red.

classes.name: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid)
classes.why: Ascorbic acid dissolves clear and colorless and fast.

classes.name: Iron supplement
classes.why: Iron salts tint the solution and some forms (fumarate) dissolve poorly.

classes.name: Protein powder
classes.why: Protein dispersions are colloidal, so scatter is high.

classes.name: Melatonin
classes.why: Doses are tiny (mg); signal is dominated by excipients. Expect near-clear.
